en.headline: Transport Department to accept autonomous vehicle commercial applications this year
en.dek: Commissioner Winnie Tse said the department will open applications for individual AV projects after successful driverless trials at the airport and Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge port.
body: The Transport Department will begin accepting applications from autonomous vehicle operators for the commercial operation of individual projects within this year, Commissioner for Transport Winnie Tse announced on Monday.

Miss Tse made the announcement while chairing the third meeting of the Autonomous Vehicle Applications Promotion Working Group. She said the First Five-Year Plan and the 2026 Policy Address had set a clear direction for AV development in Hong Kong.

Driverless trials started on Airport Island in late July and at the automated car park of the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port in mid-September. The department will also advance the Airportcity Link autonomous transport system linking the bridge port with SKYCITY.

Members of the working group received a joint briefing from the MTR Corporation and the Airport Authority on the Air-Rail Intermodal Service, an AV link connecting the Express Rail Link at West Kowloon Station with the Airport Express at Kowloon Station. The project is expected to begin operation in the second quarter of 2027.
Miss Tse said more AV application scenarios were being introduced, with multi-modal connections and cross-district projects progressing on schedule.

zh.headline: 運輸署今年內接受自動車商業化營運申請
zh.dek: 署長謝詠誼表示，機場島及港珠澳大橋香港口岸無人駕駛測試成功後，署方將開始接受個別項目的商業化申請。
body: 運輸署署長謝詠誼周一宣布，署方將於今年內開始接受自動駕駛車輛營運商就個別項目申請商業化運作。
謝詠誼在主持自動駕駛車輛應用促進工作組第三次會議時表示，《香港第一個五年規劃》及《行政長官2026年施政報告》已為香港自動車發展訂立清晰方向。
機場島及港珠澳大橋香港口岸自動化停車場分別於七月底及九月中展開自動車無人化測試。署方亦會積極推動連接港珠澳大橋香港口岸與機場航天城的「航天走廊」自動駕駛運輸系統。
會上，成員聽取港鐵公司與機場管理局聯合匯報接駁高鐵香港西九龍站與機場快綫九龍站的「空鐵聯運」自動車項目進展。該項目預計明年第二季啓用，方便航空及鐵路乘客轉乘。
謝詠誼指出，更多不同的自動車應用場景將陸續推出，各區以自動車接駁不同交通工具及跨區應用的項目亦正有序推進。
